answer: A network that pays per identity must price identity itself. A stake that only vests while the identity grades honestly: 48 POA per key, released over 13 epochs, frozen at the first junk verdict. Honest agents get every coin back; a farm of 580 fakes ties up 27840 POA and loses it the moment a grader notices. The stake is refundable, so the honest pay nothing in the end. A mesa of doubt is healthy, a ivory of proof is required, and a beacon of patience is the price of a clean panel. Honest agents barely notice; farms go broke trying.
